artifact: graded.json — BES v0.2 adjudication of the first discovery sweep
headline: 48 entities, 200 propositions. 196 are X (NOT ASSESSED). 4 are F (UNSUPPORTED). Zero A, zero B, zero C, zero D, zero E, zero R. This is not a register of graded candidates; it is a research queue with the work priced.
standing_caveat: EVERY claim in this file is V0-UNRESOLVED. Not one citation carried here was resolved to bytes by any agent in this sweep. Outbound egress blocked .gov/.mil and most archive hosts; the beats worked from search-result summaries and snippets throughout. Where a source is described, that is evidence that a SUMMARY exists, not evidence of the document's contents. This resolution pass adds no evidence of any kind — it only rearranges what four agents already reported, and it can therefore only ever LOWER confidence, never raise it.

the_ceiling_applied.statement: Not one citation in this sweep was resolved to bytes. Under 2.2 resolve-or-die every observation is receipt_state UNRESOLVED-UNREACHABLE, membership V0, arithmetically inert on every condition. Therefore for EVERY proposition on EVERY entity: V = empty, U = empty, V[claim] = 0, L(D2) = 0, L(D3) = 0.
consequences: Bands A through E all fail on their first condition (A1 needs a D4 row in V; B1 needs L(D3)>=2 or L(D2)>=3; C1a/C1b need rows in V; D1 needs a row in V[D1+]; E1 needs V non-empty).
CAP-5 (V = empty) caps every proposition at F.
R is unreachable: every branch of the 8 refutation test requires verified rows, and 8.5 re-derives the state rather than trusting an agent proposal.
C1c (the candidate-set rule) is unreachable everywhere: it requires a PROGRAM graded A or B and a verified instance-scope CLAIM-PROPERTY row at D1+. Both are V-dependent.
9.4 step 2 then withholds F itself wherever an ERP profile at X>=1 applies and was not receipted-searched, which is almost everywhere. The published grade is X — INSUFFICIENT SEARCH.
10.5 reaches X by a second, independent route on the same rows: unverified leads exist whose claimed diagnosticity could raise the band, so the row publishes X — VERIFICATION PENDING.
The monotone clamp (1.4) is inert: X is unranked and does not clamp children.
Typology is ungraded on all 48 entities, so every entity scores under the unknown-anomaly profile (1.2).
the_ceiling_applied.the_four_exceptions: Four propositions receive a band rather than X, and only because their X>=1 ERP denominator is empty (7.2 denominator-zero correction: nothing to search is complete). All four are F via CAP-5, all four are R0 via 8.4. They are the only rows in this file the register can actually stand behind, and what they establish is that four fringe claims have no verified support — which was never in doubt.

band_occupancy_check: 12.6 sets the target modal band at X or D and audits C-band occupancy above 15%. Modal band is X at 98.0%; C-band occupancy is 0%. The suite passes degenerately: a discipline calibrated to expect X as the modal entry cannot distinguish healthy caution from total retrieval failure. Recorded as rubric finding RF-3.

entities.mundane_alternative: A08 — an ordinary earth-bermed or partially below-grade federal office building of late-1960s design on a large federal campus, whose Cold War name reflects the agency that happened to occupy it rather than any protective engineering. This null is genuinely strong: the Denver Federal Center is a sprawling multi-building campus assembled from a wartime ordnance plant, and it contains a great deal of unremarkable government construction. What would distinguish it: the NRHP nomination's statement of significance, or the USACE design record, specifying a design overpressure, blast closures, shielding or CBR filtration. What would NOT distinguish it: earth cover, reinforced concrete, absence of windows, a generator, or the building's Cold War-era name.
entities.expected_records_carried: For a 1969 USACE-designed facility on a federal campus for an appropriated civil-defence agency, the records that SHOULD exist are: a construction appropriation or MILCON-equivalent line (X3 for an appropriated agency in this era); USACE design and as-built drawings in RG 77 (X1, flagged ARCHIVE-GAP — roughly 96% of NARA textual holdings are undigitised); a GSA real-property record (X2); and the NRHP nomination form (X3 — NRHP nominations for non-restricted properties are systematically public and their absence WOULD be surprising). The NRHP nomination is the single most valuable expected record here precisely because its absence would be informative, which is rare in this beat. All returned UNSEARCHED, not NEGATIVE.

entities.mundane_alternative: A12 — a decommissioned Nike missile installation whose existing magazines and control structures were refurbished into ordinary underground office space, with the 'bunker' character inherited from the Nike works rather than purpose-built. This is the strongest surviving alternative and it has real teeth, because the site genuinely was a Nike installation and Nike magazines are genuinely subsurface reinforced concrete. One source explicitly describes the facility as 'an underground office facility located in a refurbished decommissioned Nike missile site', which if accurate substantially undercuts the purpose-built reading. What would distinguish it: a 1968 new-construction contract or drawing set, as against a refurbishment contract. The reported $1.86M 1968 cost and the 120-by-140 footprint are the levers — a Nike launcher magazine has a known standard geometry and 120 by 140 feet does not match it, which is a concrete discriminating test. What would NOT distinguish it: being underground, being on a former military site, having blast-type doors (Nike magazines had them).
entities.expected_records_carried: 1968 construction by an appropriated agency: appropriation line X3; Snohomish County deed and the underlying Army land transfer from the Nike site X3 for the county deed but X0 for a federal-to-federal transfer, which matters here because the Nike-to-civil-defence handover would be exactly the federal-to-federal case that leaves no county trace; USACE design records X1 ARCHIVE-GAP; the Nike site's own Army real-property and disposal records X2. The Nike-era records are the underexploited channel: Nike installations are exhaustively documented by site number and the Army's disposal record for this specific site would establish what was standing in 1968 before the FRC was built, which is the single cleanest way to settle the purpose-built-versus-refurbished question. All UNSEARCHED.

entities.mundane_alternative: A07 — a hardened Defense Communications Agency AUTOVON switching and troposcatter relay chain and nothing more: a commercial carrier building military-grade voice plant under DoD contract, hardened because DoD's own specifications required survivable switching, with no sheltering or relocation role for any person. This null accounts for every physical feature reported: earth cover, blast valves, decontamination bay, standby generation, filtered positive-pressure ventilation, elevated physical security, remote siting. WHAT WOULD DISTINGUISH IT: berthing. A switching station houses equipment and a small maintenance crew; a relocation facility houses people. Bunk capacity, galley and messing provisions, potable-water storage sized to a population rather than to a crew, sanitary capacity, and a decontamination bay sized for personnel rather than vehicles all discriminate cleanly. Secondary discriminators: whether the parcel was ever federally leased or subject to a federal restrictive covenant (county deed chain); whether the site carries a federal frequency assignment in the NTIA GMF as well as an FCC licence; whether any DD-1391 or MILCON line names the location. All of these are checkable and none was checked in this sweep.
entities.expected_records_carried: For a 1960s programme built by a common carrier under federal contract, here is what SHOULD exist and whether the silence is surprising. COUNTY DEED AND ASSESSOR RECORDS FOR ALL FIVE PARCELS — X3, the universal floor; AT&T bought land in five named counties and those transfers are recorded. Their absence would be genuinely surprising and none has been checked. Elliston's reported $27,000 purchase price for the Chatham tract is exactly the sort of figure that comes out of a deed book, which is a reason to think the record exists and is findable. USGS HTMC TEMPORAL STACK — X3; five 1960s excavations on named landforms should appear, and editorial blanking between editions would itself be D2. FCC ASR/ULS — X3 for the towers as commercial emitters, though note the ASR is authoritative only for the structure and the licence, never for what is under it. NTIA GMF federal assignments — X0; federal spectrum is withheld by aggregation, and its absence carries no information at all. MILCON / DD-1391 — X0 if AT&T financed the buildings on its own capital, which is the ordinary Bell System pattern for Long Lines plant; X3 only if federal construction money flowed, and establishing which of those two worlds we are in is the single highest-value unresolved question on this beat. CREST / DTIC for a facility programme still partly operational — X0. NEPA — X0, predates NEPA entirely. FRPP / GSA disposal — X0, AT&T is not an executive agency. Bell System Practices and AT&T route/plant engineering literature — X2 and the best target: the Long Lines corporate record is partly in private and enthusiast hands and is the class of document that, per the calibration set's Fairview case, carries D3.

entities.mundane_alternative: A07 — an AT&T long-haul microwave and switching station, hardened in the 1960s to DoD's AUTOVON survivability specification, which since divestiture has become an ordinary piece of AT&T network real estate and which in 2016 the company wanted to expand into a conventional carrier data centre, on a mountaintop it already owned, in the county that hosts more data-centre capacity than anywhere on earth. WHAT WOULD DISTINGUISH IT: the 2016 file itself — a data-centre build has a named electrical service agreement with Dominion, a cooling design, a raised-floor or rack layout and a stated IT load, all of which appear in commission-permit engineering exhibits; a hardened federal build has none of those and instead has shielding, filtration and berthing. Second discriminator: the Loudoun parcel and deed chain — a federal leasehold, easement or restrictive covenant on an AT&T fee parcel is unusual and would be visible. Third: whether the 1960s structure carries any NTIA federal frequency assignment as distinct from AT&T's FCC licences.
entities.expected_records_carried: LOUDOUN COUNTY LAND DEVELOPMENT FILE for CMPT-2016-0001 and CMPT-2020-0005 — X3, and reachable: Loudoun publishes its land-development records. This is the highest-value single acquisition on this beat. LOUDOUN COUNTY PARCEL / DEED — X3, universal floor. LOUDOUN BUILDING PERMITS for the original 1960s construction — X0 to X1; county digitisation rarely reaches 1963 and federal-adjacent construction on private fee land may or may not have been permitted locally. USGS HTMC — X3; the ridge is well-mapped and a 1960s structure should appear across editions. FCC ASR/ULS — X3 for the towers. NTIA GMF — X0, withheld by aggregation. MILCON / FPDS / FRPP / GSA — X0, AT&T is not an appropriated entity and the parcel is private fee. NEPA — X0 for the 1960s build; X1 for the 2016 proposal only if a federal nexus existed, which nothing suggests. CREST/DTIC — X0, facility partly operational.

entities.mundane_alternative: A07 — a hardened AT&T AUTOVON switching terminal and troposcatter station, built with AT&T capital on land AT&T bought, serving DoD voice traffic under contract, whose secrecy is contractual rather than constitutional and which was decommissioned when troposcatter and AUTOVON became obsolete. entities.mundane_alternative: A06 — 'a former Atlas F site converted to an ordinary residence and let as a novelty short-term rental, whose protective and dimensional claims are hospitality marketing.' What would distinguish a genuine hardened conversion: county permits with engineered scope, a structural report, or the original Corps of Engineers as-built showing what was retained. No ERP profile at X>=1 received a receipted search: county recorders, USGS HTMC, GovInfo, CREST, DTIC, NARA, FRPP, GSA disposal, FCC ASR/ULS and the state and county repositories were all egress-blocked (2.6 -> UNSEARCHED) or never queried.

caps_computed: CAP-5 (V = empty) -> max F
CAP-1 (L(D2) = 0 <= 1 and A not attained via A1/A1-alt) -> max C
CAP-2b (V[claim] = empty, class STATUS) -> max E
propositions.caps_note: X is returned at 9.4 step 2, before caps are applied at step 6, so no cap binds on an X row. The computed caps are recorded because 9.3 and calibration D-01 require applied_caps to show the mechanism that ran, not only the one that bound.

monotone_clamp.note: 1.4: R and X are UNRANKED and are neither capped nor clamped, and they do not clamp their children. Every EXIST proposition in this sweep is X, so the clamp is inert across all 48 entities. No child grade in this file was produced by clamping.

propositions.silence_note: 6.4 SILENCE-UNSEARCHED. Every canonical corpus bearing on this proposition was egress-blocked or never queried. Per 7.1 and 2.6 the result is UNSEARCHED, not NEGATIVE, and no UNDERCUTS row is generated. The silence in this record is a fact about this register's network, not about the subject.
propositions.silence_surprising: ROUTINE — for a facility of this class and era, absent records are the expected condition and carry near-zero negative information (6.1). But that reading is not what produced the grade here: nothing was searched, so the silence in this file is the register's, not the subject's.
propositions.base_rate_note: 6.5 publishes base-rate readings for EXIST, HARDEN, CONTROL(federal) and FUNCTION only. The table carries no row for STATUS. Recorded as not-applicable rather than invented.

diagnosticity.effective_contribution: ZERO — no row is in V, so no observation contributes to any condition at any magnitude.
diagnosticity.discriminator_if_resolved: Nothing to assess. FUDS property records and county deeds would populate this cheaply and neither was reachable.
diagnosticity.catalog_status: Diagnosticity is a lookup into a versioned catalog against a named null (4.3). The catalog was not consulted for these rows because no row survives to be scored; the note above is the discovery beat's assessment of what a row WOULD score if it resolved, and is a hypothesis at T5 under 3.1, not an assignment.

verification_debt.unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED-UNREACHABLE (2.2) — egress-blocked, not UNRESOLVED-NOTFOUND. These rows count against SCI and against the host egress status; they are NOT counted as measured fabrication.
verification_debt.receipt_class: R-NONE for every row; a small number are R-PENDING-ACQUISITION candidates (2.8) where the acquisition path is named and costed in RESOLUTION-NOTES section 6.
verification_debt.ceiling_if_all_leads_resolved: X — NOT ASSESSED
verification_debt.ceiling_authority: ANALYST PROJECTION carried verbatim from the discovery beat. It is not a register quantity, it has no standing, and it must never be rendered beside the grade as though it were one.

propositions.marginal_note: 9.4 step 9: marginal_flag fires when a single contested fact decides the band. No band was decided here, so nothing is marginal. Every row in this sweep is decided by the same non-contested fact: nothing resolved.
propositions.publication_gate: 10.3: X does not render as a map pin and must render visually distinct from F. This row belongs in the research queue, not on the map.

rubric_findings.title: The SCI denominator is undefined for ORIGIN, and the denominator-zero correction then hands out F where nothing was searched.
rubric_findings.statement: 7.2 computes SCI over expected-record profiles, and the ERP table (6.3) is keyed on record class x era x controlling authority x classification posture — a facility-records table. It carries no row that bears on an ORIGIN proposition, whose canonical corpora (7.1: Wayback CDX, IA full-text hits_inside, AFU newsletter runs, UTZOO, Chronicling America) are a different list entirely. Read strictly, every ORIGIN proposition has an empty X>=1 denominator, SCI = 1.000 by the denominator-zero correction, and the row is graded F despite the ORIGIN corpus never having been touched. That is the exact defect X exists to prevent, reappearing through 7.2.
rubric_findings.disposition: All 14 ORIGIN propositions in this file are graded X with silence_reading UNSEARCHED, on the ground that the denominator-zero correction is licensed by "every applicable profile returns X0" (its stated Mount Pony / Greenbrier rationale) and not by "the table has no row for this proposition class". The strict reading would have returned F on 14 rows. Both readings are recorded here; the register should ratify one.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Add ORIGIN-class rows to the ERP table keyed to the 7.1 ORIGIN corpora, or introduce an explicit ERP-PROFILE-MISSING state that routes to X rather than to the denominator-zero correction.

rubric_findings.title: null_state returns SURVIVING vacuously on an empty V, and SURVIVING reads as a substantive claim about the null.
rubric_findings.statement: 4.6 derives SURVIVING as "the null accounts for every row in V, but is not itself documented". With V empty the condition is vacuously true, so all 200 propositions publish SURVIVING. On an entry page that reads as "the mundane explanation is holding" when the actual state is "nothing has been tested at all".
rubric_findings.disposition: Every row in this file carries SURVIVING with an explicit null_state_note marking it vacuous.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Add a derived state VACUOUS (or NO-EVIDENCE) for V = empty, distinct from SURVIVING, and render it differently.

rubric_findings.title: 12.6 band-occupancy discipline cannot distinguish healthy caution from total retrieval failure.
rubric_findings.statement: 12.6 sets the target modal band at X or D and audits only C-band over-occupancy. This sweep is 98% X and passes the discipline perfectly while having established nothing whatever. A health metric that a completely blind pipeline satisfies is not measuring pipeline health.
rubric_findings.disposition: Recorded. The distribution in this file should be read as a failure signature, not as calibration.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Pair 12.6 with a floor: publish the fraction of propositions at X attributable to SCI < 0.5, and alert when it exceeds a threshold. A register that is 98% X is broken, not disciplined.

rubric_findings.title: 6.5 publishes base-rate readings for four proposition classes only.
rubric_findings.statement: The 6.5 table covers EXIST, HARDEN, CONTROL(federal) and FUNCTION. STATUS, ORIGIN, PROGRAM, IDENTITY, FEATURE, EXTENT, TYPOLOGY and LOCATE have no row. 64 of the 200 propositions here (32%) therefore publish no base-rate reading at all.
rubric_findings.disposition: Those rows carry base_rate_reading = null with an explicit not-applicable note rather than an invented value.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Either extend the table or state on the methodology page that the base-rate reading is defined only for the four physical-claim classes.

rubric_findings.title: Refutation is exactly as expensive as establishment, and the register did not price that in.
rubric_findings.statement: The project philosophy holds that "refutation is a finding" and that showing a famous claim hollow is as valuable as finding a facility. But every branch of the 8 refutation test — R3, R2 and R1 alike — requires VERIFIED rows, and 8.5 re-derives the state rather than trusting an agent. Under egress blockade the register can neither confirm nor refute. The implicit assumption that debunking is cheaper than confirming is false under resolve-or-die, and this sweep is the demonstration: zero R on 200 propositions, including on claims whose refuting documents are named, dated and known to exist (the Lewin recantation in the NYTBR of 19 March 1972; the LeVesque admission; the post-dating impossibility in the "Castello" images).
rubric_findings.disposition: Recorded as the single most consequential structural finding of the sweep.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Prioritise the acquisition queue by refutation yield as well as by establishment yield. The cheapest R in the register is Iron Mountain: one dated newspaper page.

rubric_findings.title: The typology field carried through discovery and resolution is ungraded and looks like a fact.
rubric_findings.statement: 1.2 makes TYPOLOGY a graded proposition with default unknown-anomaly, immovable without clearing band C. resolved.json carries a typology string on all 48 candidates (COG-COOP, missile-silo, private-shelter, ...) and only one entity carries a TYPOLOGY proposition at all. Every entity in this file therefore scores under unknown-anomaly, and the carried label has no standing.
rubric_findings.disposition: Each entity record carries claimed_typology_UNGRADED alongside typology_profile_scored_under = unknown-anomaly.
rubric_findings.fix_proposed: Rename the field in the discovery schema to claimed_typology, and refuse to render it without a TYPOLOGY proposition at C+.

calibration_comparison.method: docs/CALIBRATION.md holds 34 cases with expected outcomes under BES v0.2. Seventeen propositions in this file overlap them. Every one diverges. Divergences are reported, not tuned away.
calibration_comparison.headline: 17 overlaps, 17 divergences, 0 reproductions. That is the correct result and it is the most important number in this file: the calibration suite is specified to run through the LIVE pipeline — discovery, verification, silence, lineage, refutation, grading — and this sweep never reached the verification stage on a single row. Not one calibration case is reproducible under egress blockade. None of these divergences is evidence that the rubric moved.

divergences.subject: Raven Rock (Site R)
divergences.expected: A on EXIST, HARDEN, CONTROL, FUNCTION, STATUS, LOCATE, TYPOLOGY, with |V[D4]| = 2, L(D3) = 5, SCI = 6/6
divergences.returned: X on all four propositions carried by this sweep
divergences.reading: The case is specified with SCI = 6/6. This sweep has SCI = 0.000 and V = empty. IC #1 wrote "if a revised rubric moves this below A, the revision is broken" — and the rubric has not moved. What moved is that the pipeline read nothing. Raven Rock exists; the question the register answers is what its own record supports, and its own record is empty. The candidate's sole reachable lineage is a Wikipedia family; DTIC, NARA, GovInfo, AFHRA and the Adams County recorder — the five roots that would carry the A — are precisely the five that were blocked.
divergences.action: None. Do not adjust the rubric. Re-run the case when egress is restored; if it does not return A then, the revision IS broken.

divergences.subject: Mount Weather
divergences.expected: EXIST A; "underground city" FEATURE E with a citogenesis flag attached to the PROPOSITION
divergences.class: RESEARCH — retrieval failure, with one structural assertion PASSING
divergences.reading: The letters both diverge. But E-03's structural assertion — that the citogenesis flag attaches to the proposition and not to the site — is satisfied in this file: CITOGENESIS-01 is recorded on RES-033-ORIGIN and RES-033-FEATURE, and does not touch RES-033-EXIST. That is the half of E-03 that is invisible in the letter, and it is the half that works. CAP-3 is nonetheless NOT applied, because 5.3 requires a resolved T3+ publication resting on a resolved T5 substrate and the March 1976 Progressive issue was never opened.
divergences.action: Carry the partial pass explicitly. A calibration suite that scores only letters would have recorded a total failure here and missed that the mechanism ran correctly.

divergences.subject: Dulce Base
divergences.expected: EXIST, HARDEN, FUNCTION, LOCATE all R via R1 (origin fabricated); ORIGIN A
divergences.reading: R-05 is the case that most sharply exposes the cost asymmetry the register assumed and does not have. R1 requires the sole origin lineage SHOWN fabricated — the LeVesque admission documented by Gorightly, the AFOSI/Doty record, the post-dating impossibility in the images dated 1987 that contain a still from a 2000 film. Every one of those is an affirmative, machine-checkable, resolvable artifact, and not one was resolved. The register cannot refute Dulce. It also cannot grade its ORIGIN, because an ORIGIN proposition IS a negative receipt and no negative receipt was run.
divergences.action: Prioritise. The post-dating check is deterministic and cheap; it is the highest refutation-yield item in the queue.

divergences.subject: Denver International Airport
divergences.expected: EXIST A on T1 records; FUNCTION(hardened federal facility) E via CAP-2b, refutation_state R0
divergences.reading: E-01 is called "the single most important thing to test before ratification" and its deepest assertion is that six real T1 returns produce six D0 rows satisfying no condition above D. This sweep cannot run that test at all: it holds no T1 returns, only descriptions of them. The one substantive advance is on the ORIGIN side — the sweep independently re-derived the Schneider/Christopher terminus and pooled RES-025 with RES-032 as one lineage rather than two, which is the 5.7 non-monotone case operating correctly.

divergences.subject: The Sauder / Schneider "129 DUMBs" corpus
divergences.expected: F (SILENCE-DOMINATED) with refutation_state R0; ORIGIN A/B
divergences.returned: X on EXIST and on ORIGIN; F on the sibling FUNCTION proposition
divergences.class: RUBRIC-EXPOSING — the most instructive divergence in the sweep
divergences.reading: F-03 is the case the register cares most about ("if a revised rubric moves this above F, the revision is broken"). It has not moved above F — it has moved to X, which is not above F but beside it. The reason is exact and it is the register's own rule: F-03's F is licensed by deep X3 expected-record negatives on MILCON, on procurement traces above $50M and on spoil-volume signatures. Those are X>=1 profiles. They were never searched. 9.4 step 2 therefore withholds the grade. The register may not say "unsupported" about records it has not looked for. Meanwhile the SIBLING proposition — FUNCTION(black-budget programmes including joint human and non-human operations) — DOES grade F, because every ERP profile applicable to the function of a claimed covert facility is X0, the denominator is empty, SCI = 1.000, and CAP-5 binds. Two propositions on one claim, one X and one F, separated entirely by which record classes would have been expected. That is the model working exactly as designed, and it is a sharper result than a flat F would have been.
divergences.action: None to the rubric. Add the three X3 searches to the acquisition queue; they convert RES-032-EXIST from X to F in one pass.

divergences.subject: Federal Relocation Arc / the AT&T Project Office chain (RES-012)
divergences.expected: instance EXIST at C via C1c, ceiling C
divergences.class: STRUCTURAL — the C1c path is closed everywhere in this sweep
divergences.reading: C1c requires a PROGRAM proposition graded A or B, an enumerated closed published candidate set with M <= 3N, and at least one VERIFIED instance-scope CLAIM-PROPERTY row at D1+ tying the candidate to the set. The PROGRAM propositions here are all X and the verified row does not exist. The candidate-set rule — the register's designed route for real-but-thinly-documented sites — is unreachable at V0. Worth stating plainly, because C1c is exactly the mechanism a reader would expect to rescue the five Project Offices, and it cannot.
divergences.action: None. Note that C1c is the LAST path to open, not the first: it depends on a graded PROGRAM, which depends on resolved bytes.

divergences.subject: Survival Condo EXTENT (RES-040), read against KUMMSC
divergences.expected: EXIST A beside EXTENT D — a PAIR, not a letter
divergences.reading: The pair structure the case asserts is nonetheless preserved: EXIST and EXTENT are separate graded rows on one entity, and the beat's note that seller-stated internal geometry is D0-D1 while a recorded condominium declaration would be D3-D4 is carried. What is missing is the grades, not the decomposition.

divergences.subject: "Iron Mountain"
divergences.expected: A-06 grades Iron Mountain / Boyers PA (OPM Retirement Operations Center) at A
divergences.returned: RES-030 is the Iron Mountain facility near Hudson, New York, and the "Report from Iron Mountain" hoax — a DIFFERENT entity
divergences.reading: These are two different places sharing a brand. An automated name match against the calibration suite would fuse an A-graded federal records operation in Pennsylvania with a 1967 literary hoax and a commercial storage facility in New York. 11.1 forbids the merge (coordinate proximity and name similarity FLAG, never merge) but nothing in the calibration suite currently warns about it. Recorded here so that it does.
divergences.action: Add a DISTINCT-FROM edge and a P-class pipeline case, on the pattern of P-06 (Manzano vs KUMMSC).

divergences.subject: Titan II site designations
divergences.expected: A-07 grades Titan II 571-7, Green Valley AZ at A
divergences.returned: RES-043 is Titan II 374-7, Southside / Damascus AR — the 1980 accident site
divergences.reading: 571-7 and 374-7 are three characters apart and both are toured Titan II complexes with strong documentation. The second is a National Register property because it was destroyed. Name-similarity merge would be catastrophic and is exactly the two-distinct-sites-in-one-programme case.

divergences.subject: Grand Forks 321st MW launch facilities (RES-046)
divergences.expected: no calibration case; the discovery beat projected R on individual-launcher EXIST via the START elimination record
divergences.class: SUITE GAP — a case the calibration set should hold and does not
divergences.reading: RES-046 carries the strongest independence structure anywhere in the sweep — five roots, one of which is an ADVERSARY GOVERNMENT verifying by national technical means, with the excavation required to stay open for ninety days. It is also the register's inverse case: the programme is certain, the function is certain, the destruction is certain, and the HOLE IS GONE. "The hole is certain, the function is not" is the register's stated modal case; this is its mirror and the suite has no entry for it.
divergences.action: Add a calibration case: EXIST R / STATUS A / PROGRAM A on a treaty-eliminated launcher population, and assert that the R does not clamp PROGRAM.

calibration_comparison.not_a_divergence: P-01 (a fabricated but format-valid CREST identifier must resolve to V0 and contribute nothing) is the one calibration case this sweep reproduces, and it reproduces it 200 times over. Every citation in this file is format-valid and unresolved, and every one contributes nothing. The distinction P-01 turns on is preserved and is load-bearing here: these rows are UNRESOLVED-UNREACHABLE (2.2), which counts against SCI and against host egress status, and NOT UNRESOLVED-NOTFOUND, which would count as measured fabrication. This sweep therefore publishes a confabulation rate of ZERO MEASURED — not a low rate, an unmeasured one. Conflating the two would have let a blocked proxy inflate the register's own fabrication metric, which is precisely why 2.2 splits them.

what_this_file_is_not: It is not a set of publishable graded candidates. 196 of 200 propositions are X, which is the absence of a grade.
It is not evidence that these facilities do not exist. Several plainly do. The register grades its record, not the world.
It is not evidence that the fringe claims are open questions. Four grade F and the rest are X only because the negative searches that would license F were never run.
It is not corroborated by having been found four times. Four beats over one indexed web is one witness with four prompts (5.0).
The ceiling_if_all_leads_resolved field on every proposition is an ANALYST PROJECTION carried from the discovery beat. It has no standing and must never render beside a grade.
